Use case (short): Product search + conversational shopping assistant for web storefront and customer support.

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-06-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New self-serve signup — FlowRetail (warm) 

Hi Elliott — thanks for signing up and for the details in the form. I’m Lauren on the demos team; I work with Ben for technical deep dives. Before we lock a demo slot, two quick clarifying Qs so we tailor the session and ensure we bring the right folks: 

1) Latency & SLA expectations: is the 60 concurrent estimate user-facing (strict p95 latency targets) or mainly backend batch evaluation? Do you have a target p95 (e.g., <300ms) on short prompts?

2) Data & inputs: will you send full product catalogs (tens of thousands) as embeddings, or rely on on-the-fly context only? Any expected doc size distribution (avg tokens per doc)?

3) Auth & SSO: do you require SAML SSO + SCIM for provisioning in the pilot, or is OAuth/API-key access fine to start?

4) Pilot success criteria and timeline: you noted pilot in ~6 weeks — what are the top 3 acceptance criteria (throughput, latency, relevance/accuracy)?

Proposed demo slots (PT):
- Thurs 2029-06-06 10:00–10:45
- Fri 2029-06-07 14:00–14:45
- Mon 2029-06-10 09:00–09:45

If none work, share 2 windows next week and we’ll match. We’ll scope a 35–45 minute session: 15 min qualification, 20 min demo (embedding + search + assistant flows), 10 min next steps.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Product Solutions — Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Elliott Retail <elliott@flowretail.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@flowretail.com
Date: 2029-06-01T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New self-serve signup — FlowRetail (warm)

Hey Lauren — thanks for the quick follow. Quick answers below:  

1) 60 concurrent is user-facing — our goal is <400ms p95 for short search queries (under 50 tokens). We can tolerate higher for long chat sessions.

2) We plan to embed our product catalog (~120k SKUs). Avg description length today is ~120 tokens; we’ll likely chunk into multiple vectors for richer recall. We’ll also send recent order context (small) at runtime.

3) Pilot: OAuth/API-key is fine to start. Enterprise SSO (SAML) will be required for production, but not blocking pilot.

4) Pilot criteria: (a) embedding recall > 85% for test set, (b) p95 latency < 400ms for search queries at 60 concurrency, (c) integration with our support UI by the end of pilot. Timeline: want a pilot kickoff mid-July, PoC by end of July.

Attaching a short company profile for context.

—Elliott
Elliott Retail
Director of Engineering — FlowRetail
attachments: flowretail-company-profile.pdf

Subject: Re: New self-serve signup — FlowRetail (warm)

Thanks Elliott — that helps a lot. Ben — can you lead the technical demo (embedding workstream + throughput test plan)? Ben, we should surface quantization/instance sizing and a rough autoscaling policy for 60 concurrency with a 400ms p95 target.

Elliott — I’ve tentatively held Thurs 6/6 10:00 PT as the first-choice slot while we confirm internal availability; if that works for you please accept the calendar invite. Linking our quick prep doc here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=flowretail-demo-20290605

Neha — please send Elliott the pre-demo checklist and a short list of sample data we’ll need to simulate traffic (catalog CSV + example session payloads).

Lauren
